description:
Current clients only. Use when a signed-in client has a policy with another agency that is not
    linked to their account yet and wants to bring it in. Lets the Hutsenpiller team know (it goes to
    the agency's lead router) and returns the ways to share it: canopy_connect_url (Canopy Connect,
    the client signs in to their insurance company and shares the policy securely) and/or upload_url
    (upload the declarations page). Nothing changes on any policy. line: auto, home, flood, life or
    other; carrier: the other company's name, if known. Ask the client before calling.
name: bring_in_outside_policy
title: Bring in an outside policy
